assets.prompt: Create an original finished background painting for a whimsical 1993 point-and-click graphic adventure, strongly inspired by the chunky, caricatured, goofy visual language of Day of the Tentacle. This is a drastic replacement for a realistic painterly pixel-art lab: commit to a bold hand-drawn CEL CARTOON, thick expressive dark eggplant outlines, huge simplified silhouettes, flat cel-shaded colour planes, elastic wonky perspective, deliberately crooked walls and props, humorous proportions, graphic clean shapes. No photorealism, no fine texture, no pixel dithering, no 3D, no glossy modern rendering, no subtle atmospheric painting. Use lilac/purple walls, turquoise trim, apricot/orange wooden floor, pale custard highlights, lime-green CRT phosphor, and deep plum shadows. Slightly spooky, ridiculous, warmly inviting. Original Montreal university computer science research lab; NO people, NO characters, NO user interface, NO captions, NO legible text, NO brand logos. Landscape exactly 3:2 aspect ratio, image fills edge to edge. Preserve this specific navigable adventure-room layout: left wall a giant crooked cork NOTICEBOARD, occupying x1%-20%, y2%-32%, with a few large skewed paper notices and abstract film illustrations, no words. Below and to its right, a squat wooden desk with legs leaning at unreasonable angles, an enormous bulging beige CRT COMPUTER around x11%-27%, y33%-52%, green screen, giant silly keyboard. An absurd leaning stack of RESEARCH PAPERS on the desk at x28%-44%, y39%-52%. Upper middle x43%-68% is a crooked arched WINDOW overlooking simplified Montreal brick rooftops and one green copper dome under a salmon pink sky; a pot plant with enormous droopy leaves. RIGHT REAR a tall skewed purple/teal EXIT DOOR around x74%-89%, y4%-61%, large readable brass handle, trapezoidal frame with a small absurd crack at top. Far RIGHT foreground a chunky cream RECORD PLAYER with an open clear angular dust cover and big black record, atop a warped walnut credenza at x87%-100%, y48%-65%; three giant record sleeves underneath. The lower 38% of the scene is broad clear orange wooden FLOOR with enormous uneven boards, keep x40%-80%, y65%-96% uncluttered for a game character to walk there. Add a comically giant mug, one sagging bookcase, a peculiar desk lamp, and a coiled cable, but favour a handful of big clear goofy props over tiny clutter. The scene should be immediately recognisable as a funny hand-painted cartoon adventure room and match a character with a large head and stubby heroic stance. Strong intentionally art-directed asymmetric composition. Original artwork, no recreation of any existing game's actual room or characters.

assets.prompt:
Create a NEW original full-body game character based on the supplied REAL PERSON photographs, drawn in the deliberately goofy, chunky, distorted 1993 Day of the Tentacle adventure-game style. Reference 1 is the FACE likeness authority; reference 2 is his real BODY and left tattoo sleeve; reference 3 is his CHEST TATTOO; reference 4 is the APPROVED GAME ROOM and the visual-style authority. Output ONLY the isolated fully-clothed character on REAL transparent alpha, no room, no photo background, no text. This must LOOK LIKE THE MAN in reference1, not the generic muscular spiky-haired cartoon hero from previous attempts. Preserve identifying face geometry: notably HIGH BROAD FOREHEAD and receding temples, short brown hair swept casually from his own left to right with short sides and just a modest wave on top, long oval face, broad heavy rectangular-rounded Persol-like glasses (change the photographed black acetate to BROWN TORTOISESHELL as the owner now wears), light grey-green eyes with relaxed lids, straight relatively narrow nose bridge ending in a modest rounded slightly rosy nose (not a giant hooked or ski-jump nose), dark brown moustache joining a full medium-long dark brown beard with a rounded tapered bottom, subtly lighter brown centre, just a FEW grey strands as the owner specified. A calm wry half-smile and thoughtful slightly raised brow, not a big mascot grin. Make him recognisably a white man aged48, mature but not elderly. Use the actual full-body reference for a SLIM NORMAL FIT build, natural narrow shoulders, relaxed belly and thin-to-normal forearms: absolutely NO bodybuilder chest, huge biceps, V-shaped superhero torso, or overly broad shoulders.

CRITICAL STYLE: the old character was too anatomically naturalistic and too finely shaded to fit the fourth reference room. Push this one decisively into chunky early-1990s cartoon adventure proportions: oversized expressive HEAD including beard roughly 38-40% of entire figure height, SHORT compact torso and legs, generous hands and oversized simple trainers, slightly wonky asymmetric stance. Draw thick DARK PLUM hand-inked outer contours, broad simple flat CEL-COLOUR shapes, only one bold shadow tone per colour, very few facial lines, three or four hair shapes rather than detailed individual strands. It should look drawn by the SAME HAND as the approved crooked purple room. No modern polished mascot illustration, no fine hatching, no realistic anatomy, no 3D, no airbrushing, no pixel dithering.

Wardrobe is the pale SAGE GREEN short-sleeved V-neck T-shirt from the body photo, muted blue-grey trousers, oversized off-white casual trainers. This is a full-body relaxed THREE-QUARTER RIGHT-FACING idle pose, head and toes point right while the chest faces partly toward the viewer. Show the actual anatomical LEFT-arm full Japanese sleeve, on the VIEWER'S RIGHT in this mostly front-facing stance. Use the supplied tattoo photos as shape/colour reference: flowing teal/blue-grey waves and cloud shapes, sperm whale upper arm, squid and anchor forearm, muted ink/teal/rust accents. Simplify to large cartoon tattoo motifs that read at game scale. The anatomical RIGHT arm remains UNTATTOOED. Only a SMALL TIGER FORELEG / PAW and grey-blue Japanese clouds peek over the shirt's V-neck; NO tiger head or face above the collar and most of the chest design stays under the shirt. Keep the owner fully clothed. Whole figure from hair to soles visible, centered with modest even margins. Preserve native transparency, opaque flat colours inside the figure, fully transparent outside silhouette. No floor shadow, halo, background haze, panel or watermark. Make a playful believable game adventurer who resembles these photos.

Use the supplied approved purple McGill lab ONLY as the visual-style reference: match its chunky goofy Day of the Tentacle-inspired hand-inked cel cartoon style, thick dark-plum contours, large simplified shapes, deliberately wonky perspective, expressive crooked architecture, warm custard highlights and bold teal/lilac/orange colour relationships. This is a NEW scene, not a repaint of the university lab. Original imagined NORTEL optical telecommunications equipment test lab, with multiple imposing OME metro optical equipment racks and fibre everywhere. No people or characters, no game UI, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no readable lettering. Landscape exactly 3:2, 1536x1024 composition filling the image edge to edge. Readable functional layout, built as an adventure-game background: giant gently leaning dark teal metal equipment racks occupy most of the back wall. TWO main OME RACKS sit at x29%-48%, y9%-63% and x51%-69%, y7%-64%, with stacked cream/sage card shelves, exaggerated optical connector panels, chunky ventilation grilles, and a few green and amber status lamps. Make a particularly large cream patch shelf at chest height in each main rack, simple broad connector shapes that read at game scale. A third supporting rack partly cropped at the far left x0%-15%, y2%-58% gives the lab depth. Lots of loose YELLOW and tangerine fibre patch leads loop between racks, drape over overhead teal cable ladders, and hang in giant graceful ridiculous loops; they should be playful readable lines, not a photorealistic spaghetti texture. A small wheeled PATCH BENCH sits at the left foreground x3%-27%, y46%-69%, with one conspicuous clean coiled YELLOW SPARE FIBRE lead lying on its top at x10%-23%, y45%-56%, one outsized crimp/tool shape and a squat beige service terminal with green phosphor. On the RIGHT wall, a large skewed CLIPBOARD / CIRCUIT SHEET hangs at x73%-83%, y17%-40%, with an abstract two-box circuit line drawing and some scribbles, NO legible words. At far RIGHT, tall crooked purple/teal EXIT DOOR x85%-99%, y8%-68%, chunky brass handle. Exposed conduits and one giant absurd ventilation duct up top. Keep perspective and rack scale compatible with an adult caricature shown at about half the scene height.

Lower 32%-38% is a broad CLEAR WALKABLE lab floor: warm grey/lilac square raised-floor tiles with oversized crooked seams and muted apricot/custard highlights, mostly free of equipment between x32%-84%, y67%-98%. One or two fibre loops can hug the edge but don't obstruct the central walking area. Foreground floor must give the current sage-shirt character enough space. Cool teal/lilac equipment surfaces, yellow fibre accents, green CRT, warm industrial light, dark plum shadows. Bold cel shading and huge shapes rather than realistic 3D, airbrushing, detail noise, pixel dithering or glossy rendering. Humorous, slightly lopsided, atmospheric and mechanically believable in the same cartoon world as the reference. Leave labels and interactive status to the HTML overlay; output just the complete opaque room artwork.

Create an ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for this EXACT approved original cartoon adventure-game character, using the supplied image as the character identity, outfit, proportions, linework and colour authority. Draw EIGHT different sequential WALK-CYCLE poses in a perfectly regular FOUR-COLUMN, TWO-ROW grid. Canvas landscape 1536x1024; each cell exactly384x512. Read order left-to-right top row frames1-4, then left-to-right bottom row frames5-8. EACH CELL contains ONE complete full-body character, no overlapping cells, no cropping, no labels or numbers, no grid lines. Real native TRANSPARENT ALPHA everywhere outside the characters, no ground, no cast shadows, no colour haze. Same fixed camera and same figure scale in every cell: head crown around y20 of each cell, planted shoe sole around y495, pelvis centered horizontally x192, entire pose fits within cell with margin. Keep head size, face, torso length and clothing scale IDENTICAL across all eight frames and to the reference; he must not grow, shrink or morph. His facial expression stays the same calm amused expression. Keep high forehead/receding short swept brown hair, big brown tortoiseshell glasses, full brown beard with very little grey, light skin, sage short-sleeve V-neck shirt with a tiny tiger paw/cloud at collar, muted blue-grey trousers, large cream trainers. NO new clothes or accessories. Natural slim everyday fit build and oversized caricature head. Exactly the approved chunky goofy early-1990s Day of the Tentacle-inspired inked cel style, dark plum contours, flat simple shadow planes. Do not turn him into a realistic figure or a different person.

This is a genuine fluid gait: distinct alternating footfalls, bending knees, rolling heel-to-toe, one foot passing/lifting while the other supports weight, gentle counter-swing of arms with hands OUT of pockets. Torso/head stay steady, only a tiny natural rise/fall, no whole-body shaking or bouncing. Eight phases: 1 contact left leg leading/right trailing; 2 down/compression; 3 passing right knee forward; 4 up/right leg forward; 5 opposite contact right leading/left trailing; 6 down/compression; 7 passing left knee forward; 8 up/left forward into frame1. Make the phases visibly distinct and cyclic, especially feet/arms, not eight identical idle poses. Preserve anatomical LEFT-arm full Japanese teal wave/whale/squid/anchor tattoo sleeve, right arm is bare. Do NOT mirror tattoo to opposite arm. All eight poses face the SAME direction.

DIRECTION: the character walks toward RIGHT, nose and shoes point right. Keep a three-quarter view close to the supplied right-facing approved character, with chest somewhat facing the viewer so the anatomical LEFT sleeve can remain visible. Output only this RIGHT-facing eight-frame atlas.
